title.narrative: Strengthening the capacity and ownership of States Parties to foster multistakeholder anti-doping measures to implement the Convention

description.narrative: In line with the decisions of the tenth session of the Conference of Parties (COP10), ATD activities will focus on enhancing the efficiency, sustainability and impact of the Anti-Doping Convention as instrument of international public law in the global sport integrity ecosystem, also building on the recommendations of the 2024-2025 IOS evaluation of the Convention. Through an inclusive approach centred around the intergovernmental process, main deliverables will be linked to concrete reform proposals and mechanisms. This will be done in conjunction with the strengthening of support provided to States Parties for initiatives on the ground, the implementation of regional capacity-building programmes, as well as the pursuit of key initiatives such as traditional pharmacopoeia. Work will be conducted in close collaboration with the COP10 Bureau, the Fund’s Approval Committee, and the Open-Ended Working Group.
